head.info: A unit sits under a unit; a person sits in a unit; nothing else is fixed. A team is a unit that takes orders. Open a card for its profile. No figure about one person's work is kept here.
head.infoManage: A unit sits under a unit; a person sits in a unit; nothing else is fixed. Drag a unit onto another unit, or a person onto a unit: a window asks first and says what moves. On a phone or with the keyboard, press Move…. A team has people under it, not units.

notice.made: {name} is made. Add its people now.

ready.OWNER_TEAMS: The owner and the teams: the levels are set again.
ready.SUPERVISORS: With supervisors: the levels are set again.
ready.GENERAL_MANAGER: With a general manager: the levels are set again.

tools.find: Find a person, a role or a unit
tools.chartLabel: The factory structure as a chart

failed: The factory structure could not be read.
empty: No unit yet. Start with New unit… or Ready-made….
privacy: A profile holds who a person is and where the person works. It holds no figure about one person's work.

loose.title: In no unit yet
loose.hint: Drag a person onto a unit, or open the profile and press Move….

profile.closedNote: This unit is closed. Its history stays.
profile.failed: The profile could not be read.

unit.isUnit: Another unit: a level, or a service
unit.name: Its name
unit.leaderLater: The leader and the stand-in: after you added its people.
unit.addPeopleFirst: Add people first. Then choose the leader.
unit.standIn: Who stands in when the leader is away
unit.worksForHint: A wish, not a wall: an order of any customer can still go to this team.
unit.max: Baskets at one time, at most
unit.maxHint: Empty = no limit. Over the limit is a mark, never a stop.
unit.takesNoNew: It takes no new order now
unit.ownFactsNote: Your own facts are read here. Changing them waits for the fields of teams (Admin › Fields).

held.name: Type a name first.
held.taken: A unit with this name is there already. Type another name.
held.max: Baskets at one time: a whole number from 1 to 999, or empty for no limit.
held.until: The stand-in's last day is a date.

glance.takesNoNew: It takes no new order now

overview.noLeader: Nobody leads it yet. Its people answer to the leader of the unit above.

work.noneTeam: No order now. Give one on the Teams page.
work.noneUnit: No order in the teams under it now.

person.privacy: No figure about the work of one person is kept here: no speed, no count, no rank.
person.roleHint: Your own word is fine (for example: Machine technician).
person.phoneHint: For a call from the office. Personal: only people with the personal right see it.
person.speaksHint: The floor screens follow it: Urdu words and a voice for a person who reads Urdu.

held.since: With us since: choose a date.
held.speaks: Choose the language the person reads and speaks.

refused.gone: This is not in the factory structure any more.
refused.self: A unit cannot go under itself or a unit under it.
refused.team: A team has people under it, not units.

move.title: Move {name}
move.pickUnit: Choose the unit it goes under. Its people and its orders go with it.
move.askUnit_one: {name} goes under {to}. Its {count} person goes with it.
move.askUnit_other: {name} goes under {to}. Its people ({count}) and its orders go with it.
move.askPersonFrom: {name} goes from {from} to {to}. It is the new home unit from today.
move.askPerson: {name} goes to {to}. It is the home unit from today.

merge.title: Merge {name} with…
merge.pickTeams: Tick one team or more. All of them become ONE team.
merge.pickUnits: Tick one unit or more. All of them become ONE unit.
merge.none: No unit of this kind to merge with.
merge.keep: Which profile stays (its picture, its place in the factory structure)?
merge.nameTeam: The name of the one team
merge.nameUnit: The name of the one unit
merge.movesTeam_one: {count} person and the open orders move to it.
merge.movesTeam_other: {count} people and the open orders move to it.
merge.closedNote_one: The other one is closed, not erased: its history stays. A leader who does not lead any more becomes a member.
merge.closedNote_other: The other {count} are closed, not erased: their history stays. A leader who does not lead any more becomes a member.

held.name: Type the name of the one unit.

close.top: The top unit cannot be closed.
close.units_one: Move the {count} unit under it to another unit.
close.units_other: Move the {count} units under it to another unit.
close.people_one: Move its {count} person to another unit.
close.people_other: Move its {count} people to another unit.
close.orders_one: Give its {count} open order to another team.
close.orders_other: Give its {count} open orders to another team.
close.title: Close {name}?
close.orMerge: Or merge it with another unit: then its people and its orders move in one step.
close.kept: It is closed and kept: nothing is erased, its history stays. It leaves the chart.

ready.title: Ready-made factory structures
ready.subtitle: Start from one. Then change it as you like.

OWNER_TEAMS.name: The owner and the teams
OWNER_TEAMS.does: The owner leads every team and every service. No level between.

SUPERVISORS.name: With supervisors
SUPERVISORS.does: The owner → supervisors → teams. Services beside them.

GENERAL_MANAGER.name: With a general manager
GENERAL_MANAGER.does: The owner → the general manager → supervisors → teams.

ready.nothing: Nothing changes: the levels are like this already.
ready.note: Teams, people and orders stay as they are. Only the levels above the teams are set again. The history of each unit keeps the change.

add.title: Add a person
add.subtitle: A new person of the factory.

held.name: Type the first name and the family name.

error.write: It was not saved. Try again.
error.offline: No answer from the factory: check the network and try again.
error.notFound: It is not there any more.
error.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: it was read again. Check it and try again.
error.invalid: It was refused as it is: check what you typed.
